# Synthetic test inputs

The application author confirmed creating the phone-AI corpus and application
artwork on 2026-11-02. The phone-AI records exercise retrieval, categorization and
note generation; their sample social URLs are fixture identifiers, not inputs to
fetch from live sites. Tests use fake providers and local content.

Pairing/recovery fixtures contain deliberate synthetic cryptographic test vectors.
They are not credentials for a real library or account. Other tests generate fresh
keys and temporary libraries at runtime. Never replace these inputs with personal
reports, transcripts, tokens, receipts or recovery material.

Application-owned fixture content follows the root LICENSE at this revision.
